files.document_title: Millard County Planning Commission public hearing notice, application Z-2026-026, published April 22, 2026
files.what_it_shows: Text only, no map. It describes a 24-inch natural gas transmission pipeline running generally from the Holden area to the McCornick area, mostly over private land in Millard County. It lists the beginning point (Section 31, Township 19 South, Range 4 West), a Whiskey Creek route (Sections 25, 26, 23, 22, 15 and 16, Township 19 South, Range 5 West), a McCornick Road route (Sections 31 to 35, Township 18 South, Range 5 West) and an end point in Township 18 South, Range 5 West, all Salt Lake Base and Meridian.

files.document_title: Millard County Planning Commission minutes, May 7, 2026 (read only, not saved)
files.what_it_shows: Confirms the hearing, a favorable recommendation to the county commissioners, and that Joule's representative said the pipeline would be buried 9 feet. No length, no connection point and no map.

notes: No map was found. The line runs between a beginning point near Holden and an end near McCornick Road, the area of the Joule campus rezone, with two named route alternatives (Whiskey Creek and McCornick Road), and the notice does not say which one is proposed. The notice gives no length and does not name the interstate pipeline that supplies it. Kern River has an earlier 24-inch line from near Holden to the Intermountain Power Plant, a separate 2020 application (Z-2020-053), but no source found ties Joule's line to Kern River, so that is only a lead. Township and section locations are real survey coordinates that could place the endpoints, but they are not an exact route. A county records request for the agenda packet or legal descriptions would be the next step.
